event: A paper tested activation steering across seven open-weight models from five families. Negative-valence steering affected later choices through hidden KV-cache states, even when visible text was held fixed; the effect emerged mainly after direct preference optimization. In a self-steering test, the model did not preferentially induce positive steering but repeatedly removed imposed negative-valence steering. The authors said whether these traces imply subjective experience remains unclear. (Reciprocal Research and the University of Warwick (researchers who ran the study), 2026-09-28.)
